preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < n for edge in prerequisites for x in edge)
preconditions.description: All course labels in prerequisites are valid (0 ≤ course < n).
The number of prerequisite pairs does not exceed the maximum possible edges in a directed graph with n nodes.

postconditions.expression: return_value == not any(course in cycle for course in range(n) for cycle in strongly_connected_components(prerequisites))
postconditions.description: The output is true if and only if the directed graph of prerequisites has no cycles (i.e., no course is part of a cyclic dependency).
